hypothesis: A fixed 24-hour SP500 maximum hold whose deadline falls during XYZ internal weekend pricing may have worse liquidity and may crystallize internal-session basis, but the current position size can remain technically executable and protected despite that relative degradation.
decision: Do not close, resize, restart, hot-change, or alter the open V58 lifecycle. The fixed sample through 2026-08-22T01:00:00Z shows a real internal-session liquidity decline but full 0.223-unit bid-side fillability in every snapshot and less than 1 bp maximum modeled depth-walk slippage. Preregister terminal, final-external-boundary, and next-external-reopening comparisons; require repeated weekend-crossing evidence before proposing a session-aware live exit policy.
falsifier: Supersede this disposition if later pre-deadline evidence shows insufficient 0.223-unit bid depth, materially worse stressed slippage, mark/oracle staleness, a missing or rejected protective stop, a venue fault, or if source-complete terminal and reopening comparisons across at least five exact-route lifecycles and three weekends show positive after-cost session-aware improvement excluding the largest winner without a worse loss tail.

recommendation_contract.recommendation: Retain the open lifecycle under its bound V58 contract and complete the preregistered terminal comparison.
recommendation_contract.why_now: The position opened Friday and its fixed maximum-hold deadline falls Saturday, after XYZ switches from external index pricing to internal weekend price discovery.
recommendation_contract.evidence_reviewed: Exact public SP500 L2, public trades, asset-context mark/oracle observations, live lifecycle identity, venue-native stop identity, V58 execution plan, and current official Hyperliquid/XYZ HIP-3 pricing documentation.
recommendation_contract.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Weekend liquidity is worse in relative terms and the deadline price is internally discovered, but observed absolute exit capacity remains ample at the current size.
recommendation_contract.applicable_market_regime: XYZ internal off-hours and weekend price discovery after the Friday external index-futures boundary.
alternatives_considered: emergency reduce-only close before the deadline
hot-change the active lifecycle to a session-aware timer
extend through the weekend until external pricing reopens
retain the frozen lifecycle and measure all three boundaries
recommendation_contract.expected_upside: Avoid an unvalidated intervention while preserving exact evidence needed to decide whether future SP500 deadlines should be session-aware.
recommendation_contract.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Liquidity may deteriorate after the fixed sample, internal price discovery may diverge from the next external reference, and a reachable weekend mark can trigger the stop even without a live external index move.
recommendation_contract.validation_completed: Fixed half-open window comparison across cash, external-futures, Friday-internal, and Saturday-internal states; full bid-ladder walk at the actual size; trade cadence/notional; mark/oracle divergence and context cadence; duplicate checks; source-part composite identities; official pricing-contract review.
recommendation_contract.validation_still_required: Continuous evidence through the actual terminal event, exact fill/fee/funding/protection reconciliation, next external-price reopening, and repeated source-complete weekend-crossing lifecycles or historical event replay.
recommendation_contract.success_metrics: Exact terminal reconciliation; no protection fault; complete boundary coverage; positive after-cost session-aware improvement excluding the largest winner across at least five lifecycles and three weekends before any policy proposal.
recommendation_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: No live rollout exists. Escalate if current-size fillability fails, slippage becomes material, context becomes stale, or protection/order state faults.
recommendation_contract.confidence_level: High for observed current-size technical feasibility through 01:00Z; low for deadline liquidity or session-aware economic superiority.
